primitives.note: Shield of Daybreak arms Leona's next basic attack within 6s to deal bonus magic damage (10-110 +0.3 AP) and apply CC; the attack has uncancellable windup and bonus range

Q's empowered attack resets the basic attack timer and does not put the basic attack on cooldown, effectively granting a second reset; E orders an automatic basic attack against the dash target once the dash completes
mana costs (Q 30-50, W 60, E 40-60, R 100) that can constrain how often abilities are cast inside the 15s window
W's detonation, E's sword-flight damage, and R's delayed-impact damage each deal a fixed on-cast/on-delay magic damage instance on cooldown

Eclipse grants flat pre-mitigation damage reduction (capped at 50% of the instance) plus bonus armor and bonus MR for 3s (extended to 6s if the detonation hits an enemy) — relevant to the survival fight
Leona is locked out of moving or attacking while Zenith Blade's sword is in flight, though she may still cast other abilities during the dash

needsBespoke.why: Against a single stationary dummy, Eclipse's detonation will always hit and its guard-duration extension therefore resolves deterministically (always +3s), so no bespoke conditional logic is needed there. Sunlight's bonus damage requires an allied champion to consume the mark; since neither fight type includes allies, this passive simply never fires and needs no primitive or bespoke handling — it is inert in this simulation rather than something requiring special logic.

unsettled.question: Does Leona's own basic attacks/abilities ever count as the 'allied champion' consumption needed to trigger Sunlight's bonus magic damage, or is that damage strictly unavailable to her in a 1v1 fight with no allies present?
options: Sunlight's bonus damage can never be dealt in a solo (no-ally) fight, since the wiki explicitly attributes the consuming hit to 'allied champions'' attacks, distinct from Leona herself
The simulator should assume some proxy trigger (e.g. treat Leona's own follow-up hit as consuming the mark) to include Sunlight's damage in the fight

unsettled.question: Does Shield of Daybreak (Q) itself have a 0.25s cast time (as the bin's castTime field states) or is it effectively instant/none (as the wiki's 'cast time = none' states), affecting how tightly it can be weaved with auto-attacks in the DPS rotation?
options: Q has a real 0.25s cast time per the bin, delaying the next action by that amount
Q has no cast time (instant, attack-command style) per the wiki, and the bin's castTime field is not reflecting live behavior

options: Trust the wiki's pplevel curve (32 to 151) as-is for whatever level is simulated
Treat Sunlight's exact per-level value as unverified/unknown pending the resolved bin formula

proposal: Open by casting Q (Shield of Daybreak) to arm the next basic attack, then auto-attack the dummy to land Q's bonus magic damage, stun, and trigger Q's extra attack reset.
Immediately follow with W (Eclipse) to gain the guard buff and queue its detonation damage 3s later (extended to 6s of guard since the detonation will hit the stationary dummy).
Cast E (Zenith Blade) at the dummy for its on-flight magic damage; accept the brief lockout on movement/attacks while the sword travels, then let the automatic post-dash basic attack fire.

Cast R (Solar Flare) once available (likely only once given its 60-90s cooldown) for its large delayed magic damage burst, since the target is stationary and guaranteed to be hit including by the epicenter.

Fill all remaining time with basic attacks, recasting Q every 5s (re-arming the empowered attack each time it's off cooldown) and recasting W and E on their cooldowns to add their detonation/sword damage instances.

Prioritize keeping Q and auto-attacks uninterrupted since they have the shortest cooldown and generate the most attack resets; treat E's cast as a brief DPS pause due to the lockout during sword flight.

At what level/rank assumptions should Leona be simulated (this affects whether R can be cast once or twice in the 15s window, and which rank's cooldown reduction applies)?
Does E's forced auto-attack after the dash count toward Sunlight's 'ability hit' marking for consistency, or only Leona's actual spell casts?
